description: Gardening/Flower Arrangement system - decorative garden plots, flower varieties (rose, lily, tulip, sunflower), arrangement beauty scoring, garden competitions (NPC judged), new NPC gardener judge Flora
steps: Add new flower/gardening items to packages/shared/src/items.ts: rose, lily, tulip, sunflower, garden_plot, flower_arrangement. Add to ItemId union type and ITEM_DEFINITIONS with appropriate stackSizes.
Add prices for the new items in packages/shared/src/economy.ts ITEM_PRICES.

Create packages/game-engine/src/gardening/gardeningDefinitions.ts with FlowerVariety enum (ROSE, LILY, TULIP, SUNFLOWER), GardenPlot interface, ArrangementScoring rules (beauty points per flower, variety bonus, seasonal bonus), CompetitionTier enum (bronze, silver, gold), and NPC judge scoring thresholds.

Create packages/game-engine/src/gardening/gardeningOps.ts with pure functions: plantFlower, waterGarden, harvestFlower, createArrangement, scoreArrangement, enterCompetition, judgeCompetition. These operate on a GardeningState interface.
Create packages/game-engine/src/gardening/index.ts exporting all definitions, types, and ops.

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/GardeningComponent.ts extending Component with type 'gardening'. Data: gardenPlots array, arrangements array, competitionHistory, waterLevel, lastWateredTime, version counter, and request fields (pendingPlant, pendingWater, pendingArrange, pendingCompete).

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/GardeningSystem.ts extending System with requiredComponents ['gardening', 'inventory', 'wallet']. Consumes request fields, calls gardeningOps, awards coins for competition wins.
Add new NPC 'gardener_flora' to packages/game-engine/src/world/NpcCatalogue.ts with role 'gardener' (add to NpcRole type), schedule entries, anchorTile near village.
Add 'npc.activity.gardening' to the NpcActivity type in world/npcSchedule.ts and the NPC_ACTIVITY_KEYS in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts.

Add new achievement conditions to packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementDefinitions.ts: { kind: 'garden_arrangements'; count: number }, { kind: 'garden_competition_wins'; count: number }. Add corresponding fields to AchievementSource interface. Add 3 achievement definitions: first_arrangement, garden_master (5 arrangements), competition_winner.
Add GardeningComponent export to packages/game-engine/src/components/index.ts, GardeningSystem to systems/index.ts, and add all gardening exports to packages/game-engine/src/index.ts.

Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/gardening.test.ts with comprehensive tests for gardeningOps (planting, watering, harvesting, arrangement scoring, competition judging) and GardeningSystem (request consumption, inventory interactions, wallet rewards).

Add all i18n keys to apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en.ts: npc.flora.name, dialogue.flora.*, item.rose, item.lily, item.tulip, item.sunflower, item.garden_plot, item.flower_arrangement, gardening.title, gardening.plant, gardening.water, gardening.arrange, gardening.compete, gardening.score, gardening.competition.*, achievement.first_arrangement.*, achievement.garden_master.*, achievement.competition_winner.*
Add ITEM_NAME_KEYS entries for the 6 new items in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts.
Add translations to all 11 non-English locale files (ko, ja, zh, es, fr, de, pt, ar, hi, th, vi) with properly translated strings (not English copies).
Run pnpm format to auto-format all changes, then verify with pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test.
acceptance_criteria: 6 new items added to shared items.ts with prices in economy.ts
gardeningDefinitions.ts and gardeningOps.ts implement full flower/arrangement/competition logic
GardeningComponent is a pure data container, GardeningSystem consumes requests and calls ops
New NPC Flora added to NpcCatalogue with gardener role and schedule
3 new achievements tied to gardening system
All i18n keys present in all 12 locales, translations differ from English
gardening.test.ts covers planting, watering, harvesting, scoring, competition, and system integration
pnpm build passes, pnpm test passes, pnpm lint passes, pnpm format:check passes
